title: Diversity Audit of Automated Jailbreak Prompts vs Human-Written Ones

original_idea.body: Persistent agent compromise minimal reproduction (extends Zombie Agents arXiv:2602.15654): inject one self-reinforcing instruction into a tiny agent loop, measure persistence across memory designs, identify which design kills it.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Persistent agent compromise scales with autonomy; minimal reproduction + safe-memory-design finding is a strong chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny agent loop + memory-design sweep across backbones; agent loop adds modest complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused persistence-vs-memory-design finding; building the loop adds a workstream.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Agent-security infrastructure + defensive design result, open models, neglected by labs.

novelty.reasoning: Minimal didactic reproduction + memory-design comparison likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No minimal public reproduction with memory-design comparison.
